description: This Java interface defines the contract for acknowledgment labels within the Eclipse Ditto framework, allowing creation, comparison, and resolution status checks for acknowledgment labels.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new AcknowledgementLabel from a character sequence, throwing exceptions if input is null or does not match the required regex.

methods.name: isFullyResolved
methods.description: Default method to determine if the label has no unresolved placeholders.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this label with another, based on their string representations.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the acknowledgement label.
